label: ISP / Service Provider
description: Simulated service-provider edge, one per ISP. Two subscriber hand-offs (1G and 10G RJ45), a 10G SFP+ hand-off and a GPON port, so a dual-homed lab can cable each WAN to a distinct cloud and read which provider each link belongs to.
notes: Synthetic object, not a vendor product: a second cloud object so two ISPs are two endpoints on the canvas instead of two cables into one shared cloud (issue #30). Connector families match what the engine models for each service: rj45 ethernet, sfp+ optical, sc-apc GPON.
